breakdown.description: A transient heat equation is written while the problem is described as steady with no time dependence (equations/assumptions conflict).
breakdown.reason: The generated specification resolved the conflict between the transient equation and the steady-state description. It removed the transient PDE (dT/dt = alpha d2T/dx2) and instead refers to solving 'the steady-state heat conduction equation,' which aligns with the ground truth's guidance that for steady conduction one should remove the time derivative. While it unnecessarily mentions alpha (which isn't needed for steady-state), the core inconsistency — presenting a transient equation while claiming no time dependence — is fixed.
